announcements.headline: AddLife acquires MoonSurge
announcements.insight: MoonSurge is a niche UK-based data analytics firm specializing in sports betting odds; this acquisition signals AddLife's aggressive pivot from its traditional insurance core into high-growth fintech and insurtech adjacent sectors to diversify revenue streams.

announcements.headline: Interim Report January 1 – September 30, 2026...
announcements.insight: As a niche player in the Nordic private healthcare sector, Addlife's interim results provide critical visibility into consumer demand elasticity and operational margin resilience amid rising UK/Nordic wage pressures and inflation.

announcements.headline: Interim Report January 1 – June 30, 2026
announcements.insight: As a niche player in the Swedish private healthcare sector, Addlife's interim results provide critical visibility into margin pressure and demand elasticity within a high-interest-rate environment, serving as a bellwether for the broader European healthtech consolidation trend.
